A '''synthcube''' was smaller than the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] named [[Voidhound]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I should have you beaten. I should lock you in that cell and cut you down to synthcubes and water. I should&hellip; should&hellip;|Kay Cavarat|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Synthcubes were introduced in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] player character chooses to set free [[Ivory]]&mdash;a criminal under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]&mdash;and selects flirting dialogue options with Republic [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Kay Cavarat]] in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], an angry Cavaret would rant that she ought to beat up and [[Prison/Legends|imprison]] the smuggler in a cell and cut him down to synthcubes and [[Water/Legends|water]]. The impassioned Cavaret then slaps the smuggler in the face before kissing him and taking him to [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]].
